newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Chirac leaves Gaza for Amman.
newsitem.headline: Chirac leaves Gaza for Amman.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac left Gaza for Jordan on Wednesday after a one-day trip to PLO-ruled areas during which he became the first foreign leader to address the Palestinian legisalture, witnesses said.

They said Chirac, who is on a Middle East tour, boarded a French helicopter in Gaza and flew towards an Egyptian military base where he will take a plan a Amman. Chirac inaugurated a street named after the late French president Charles de Gaulle and toured the site of a future sea port which will be financed partly by France.
